# Chrome

*Product* · also written Google Chrome

Google's web browser; Googlebot renders pages with an up-to-date version of the same Chromium engine, and Chrome's developer tools help debug rendering.

13 claims mention it: 2 from Google's documentation, 10 shown or said at the event (3 not in Google docs, 2 confirmed by Google docs, 4 consistent with Google docs, 1 nothing to verify), 1 the author's analysis. A card is a map: cite the claim ids, with the citation given after each claim.

## Google's documentation

Documented in: [Search with Google Lens in Chrome](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/15086890?hl=en).

- [`D1-C316`](../sessions/D1-S04-lightning-session-a-automation-and-ai.md) Docs: Chrome's WebMCP documentation describes WebMCP as a proposed web standard that site owners can test through an origin trial starting in Chrome 149 or through a Chrome flag for local development. `[D1-C316, docs, Chrome for Developers, https://developer.chrome.com/docs/ai/webmcp]`
- [`D1-C460`](../sessions/D1-S12-q-a.md) Docs: Chrome's Lighthouse documentation lists an llms.txt audit among its agentic browsing audits: it flags a server error when llms.txt is fetched and marks the audit not applicable when the file is missing, because providing the file is optional for now. `[D1-C460, docs, Chrome for Developers, https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/agentic-browsing/llms-txt]`

## Shown or said at the event

Not in Google's documentation first: present those as said at Search Central Live, never as documented policy.

- [`D2-C162`](../sessions/D2-S05-lightning-session-d-rendering-and-javascript.md) Stage, Day 2, not in Google docs: A community speaker strongly advised SEOs to use Chrome DevTools more often to understand what happens when their pages render. `[D2-C162, stage, Sören Bendig, Day 2]`
- [`D2-C180`](../sessions/D2-S05-lightning-session-d-rendering-and-javascript.md) Stage, Day 2, not in Google docs: If content is missing from the rendered HTML, find the script responsible in Chrome DevTools: open the Network tab, filter by Fetch/XHR and reload the page. `[D2-C180, stage, Rebecca Yu, Day 2]`
- [`D2-C860`](../sessions/D2-S05-lightning-session-d-rendering-and-javascript.md) Stage, Day 2, not in Google docs: Besides using Chrome DevTools more often, a community speaker advised checking rendering at scale with a modern crawler. `[D2-C860, stage, Sören Bendig, Day 2]`
- [`D2-C126`](../sessions/D2-S05-lightning-session-d-rendering-and-javascript.md) Stage, Day 2, confirmed by Google docs: Google renders pages with Chromium, the browser technology that also underlies Chrome, Edge and other Chromium-based browsers. `[D2-C126, stage, Erin Sparling, Day 2]`
- [`D3-C458`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, confirmed by Google docs: Multimodal searches reported in Search Console include searches with Google Lens, Circle to Search on Android, images uploaded to Google Search and Chrome's right-click search on an image. `[D3-C458, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`
- [`D2-C094`](../sessions/D2-S04-controlling-indexing.md) Stage, Day 2, consistent with Google docs: John Mueller said notranslate can also be set in a meta tag named google, and that in that form it also turns off Chrome's automatic translation of the page. `[D2-C094, stage, John Mueller, Day 2]`
- [`D2-C181`](../sessions/D2-S05-lightning-session-d-rendering-and-javascript.md) Stage, Day 2, consistent with Google docs: For each suspect script or API request in Chrome DevTools, check whether it runs, whether something blocks it and whether robots.txt disallows it. `[D2-C181, stage, Rebecca Yu, Day 2]`
- [`D2-C465`](../sessions/D2-S12-what-is-structured-data-and-why-we-need-it-on-the-internet.md) Stage, Day 2, consistent with Google docs: Gemini in Chrome relies heavily on the screenshot it takes of a page. `[D2-C465, stage, Google, Day 2]`
- [`D3-C461`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, consistent with Google docs: In a demo, asking Chrome about an image on a web page opened a side panel of visual matches, one of which was on Google's developers site and led on to more information about Search Console; Google described this as the full flow of the multimodal traffic now reported. `[D3-C461, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`
- [`D1-C249`](../sessions/D1-S04-lightning-session-a-automation-and-ai.md) Stage, Day 1, nothing to verify: A community demo showed a script that opens Chrome with a saved session, pastes a URL into Google's Rich Results Test, waits about 15 seconds, then screenshots and saves the result and retries on failure (the demo's recording is largely unintelligible; the tool name is a best reading). `[D1-C249, stage, a community speaker, Day 1]`

## The author's analysis

- [`D2-C098`](../sessions/D2-S04-controlling-indexing.md) Analysis: International sites should remove notranslate from their templates unless translation must be prevented: the robots or googlebot form switches off Google Search's translation features, and John Mueller said the form named google also blocks Chrome's translation for visitors who do not read the language. `[D2-C098, analysis, Ibrahim Anjro]`
